evidence: X-ray diffraction (XRD) measures were performed in Bragg-Brentano configuration at 1.5406 Å wavelength. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) roughness maps were done on a Veeco/Digital Instruments NanoScope Dimension 3100 in tapping mode at 1 Hz. Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS) was performed with a 2.0 MeV 4He incident ion beam and a backscattering angle of 170 ◦. Time of Flight Elastic Recoil Detection Analysis (ToF-ERDA) was performed using 38 MeV 127I incident ions. Thickness measurements were performed by spectroscopic ellipsometry. Film composition was determined by ToF-ERDA. XRD analysis was performed on 50 nm thick samples. Surface morphology measurements were performed by AFM. TEM cross-section of a 12 nm thick Tm2O3 layer was examined. Electrical characterization was performed on MOS capacitors by means of a HP 4284A LCR meter connected to a Cascade 11000 probe station. Capacitance-voltage (CV) measurements were performed.
